{

      "area": "money",

      "quote": "pls give my Robux back pls give the amount of Robux back that I had on the card and If u won’t I’m sorry but I’ll have to tell the bank that a game has caused fraud and this will be spoken to my lawyer and my mothers"

    },
    {
      "ref": "[R12]",

This app is unsafe for children and does not have clear boundaries for ages, even in an adult servers are you cannot speak freely, regardless of the lying advertising for it, and in children’s servers adults can join and chat with your kids."

      "ref": "[R21]",

      "claim": "A user requests a refund feature because they have bought items they regret and want to be able to return them.",

      "quote": "I am still waiting for you guys to add a refund feature I am pretty sure we all wanted to refund an item we bought because of how it looked and I know it’s not that hard to add a refund feature"

    {
      "ref": "[R22]",

      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Remove age groups pls"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R26]",
      "area": "age_gating",

    {

    {
      "ref": "[R34]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A reviewer begs Roblox to bring back chat, stating many games are ruined without it.",
